sources.note: Page 2, MTH-Match, Tactical, Hunting: Caliber .338, Grains 275, Minimum Required Twist *1-9.5", Part Number MTH 338 275, G1 BC .826(.801 A.B), G7 BC .412 (A.B.), OAL 1.863", Bullet Projection 1.036"
